quantifier: For every unit direction zeta and every a>0, the absolute tail gap is at most U' alpha^(1/4) log(1/alpha)^(1/2) / a for sufficiently small alpha.
operationalization: Four unit directions, four positive thresholds, five stepsizes, all three iid model families, and seed-wise binomial uncertainty.
acceptance: A constant calibrated only on coarse stepsizes upper-bounds all fine-step upper confidence gaps normalized by alpha^(1/4)sqrt(log)/a.
The target variance uses the direction-specific Lyapunov covariance.
Wrong target/rate controls are reported and fail where intended.
